# semaphore_ex_project_template_inventory (Resource)

Attaches an additional inventory to a template. The template's inventory_id selects its default inventory. Destroy detaches this association and preserves the inventory itself.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_project_template_inventory" "extra" {
  project_id   = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  template_id  = semaphore_ex_project_template.example.id
  inventory_id = semaphore_ex_project_inventory.extra.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inventory_id` (Number) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Inventory to attach. An inventory can belong to only one template. Value must be at least 1.
- `project_id` (Number) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Project containing the template and inventory. Value must be at least 1.
- `template_id` (Number) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Template receiving the inventory. Value must be at least 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Compound association identity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import semaphore_ex_project_template_inventory.extra project/1/template/2/inventory/3
```
